title: Block Global Installs
summary: A Claude Code hook that refuses global npm, pnpm, yarn, pip and gem installs so tools are added to the project and not to your whole machine.
description: An agent that needs a missing tool will sometimes install it globally, which changes your machine and hides the dependency from the next person. Each shell call is inspected first, and the machine-wide forms are turned away.

It catches npm and pnpm with a global flag, yarn global, gem install without a user or bundle setup, and pip install when no virtual environment is active. The message tells the agent to add the tool to the project instead.
useWhen: Keep a laptop free of tools the project should declare
Make every dependency show up in the lockfile
Work in a repo with a pinned toolchain
Stop pip from touching the system Python

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const c=String(i.command||'').replace(/\x22[^\x22]*\x22|\x27[^\x27]*\x27/g,' ')+' ';const e=process.env.VIRTUAL_ENV;const rules=[[/(^|[ ])npm[ ]+(i|install|add)[ ].*(-g|--global)[ ]/.test(c),'npm install -g'],[/pnpm[ ]+(add|install|i)[ ].*(-g|--global)[ ]/.test(c),'pnpm add -g'],[/yarn[ ]+global[ ]/.test(c),'yarn global'],[/gem[ ]+install[ ]/.test(c)&&!/--user-install|--install-dir|bundle/.test(c),'gem install'],[/pip3?[ ]+install[ ]/.test(c)&&!e&&!/venv|--target|[ ]-t[ ]/.test(c),'pip install outside a virtual environment']];const h=rules.find(r=>r[0]);if(h){console.error('Blocked: '+h[1]+' would change the whole machine. Install the tool in the project instead (devDependencies, a virtualenv, or the Gemfile) and run it through npx, python -m or bundle exec.');process.exitCode=2}})"

example.prompt: Install typescript globally so tsc works everywhere.
example.result: The global install is refused. The agent adds typescript as a dev dependency and calls it with npx tsc instead.

faq.question: Why does pip install get blocked at times?
faq.answer: The hook checks the VIRTUAL_ENV variable. Activate your virtualenv before starting Claude Code, or call the venv pip by path, and it passes.

faq.question: Does a local npm install still work?
faq.answer: Yes. Only commands with a global flag are refused, so plain installs inside the project are untouched.

access: Reads each Bash command and the VIRTUAL_ENV variable
Blocks matching commands and runs nothing itself
